messages:
alex: Heads-up — I'm preparing to add two new streaming fields to chat/completions (client_sent_tokens and server_flush_id) and extend tool_call with an optional "meta" object. Want to confirm backward compatibility expectations before I open a PR.

maria: Thanks — can you paste the proposed schema change? Trying to see if we can avoid breaking existing SDK parsers.

alex: Sure, here's the diff I'm thinking:
```json
"choices": [
  {
    "delta": {"role": "assistant", "content": "...", "client_sent_tokens": 123},
    "finish_reason": null
  }
],
"tool_call": {
  "name": "extract_entities",
  "arguments": "{...}",
  "meta": {"version": "v1", "confidence": 0.92}
}
```
Note: streaming would emit `delta.client_sent_tokens` intermittently, and final responses may include `server_flush_id` at end-of-stream.

sam: Two quick things — 1) keep new streaming fields optional and nullable so older clients ignore them; 2) avoid changing existing keys or types.

priya: For SDKs, we treat unknown fields as opaque maps. But some JSON-schema validators will fail if `meta` is not defined in our schema. We should publish a schema bump and deprecation note.

alex: Agreed. Proposal: Add `tool_call.meta` as optional map<string,any>. Streaming fields optional ints/strings. We'll tag schema version 1.2 and add migration notes. Any objections?

maria: No objections. Also: ensure gateway doesn't strip unknown fields when forwarding to dedicated/private deployments.

dev-bot: deploy-check: lint/api-schema -> passed

sam: I'll add a unit test in runtime to ensure older client messages with no `client_sent_tokens` still parse.

priya: I'll draft a short CHANGELOG entry and an email to integrators.

alex: Cool — I'll open the PR with the schema, tests, and changelog. @sam @priya @maria please review when it's up. :thumbsup:
